command:
set -u
A=http://localhost:3000
for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sf "$A/api/healthz" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done
gitea admin user create --admin --username "$GITEA_ADMIN_USER" --password "$GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD" --email "$GITEA_ADMIN_USER@kradle.local" --must-change-password=false 2>/dev/null || true
AUTH="$GITEA_ADMIN_USER:$GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD"
if [ -n "$KRADLE_BOOTSTRAP_ORG" ]; then
  curl -s -o /dev/null -u "$AUTH" -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"username\":\"$KRADLE_BOOTSTRAP_ORG\",\"visibility\":\"private\"}" "$A/api/v1/orgs" || true
fi
if [ -n "$KRADLE_BOOTSTRAP_ORG" ] && [ -n "$KRADLE_BOOTSTRAP_SANDBOX_REPO" ]; then
  curl -s -o /dev/null -u "$AUTH" -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"name\":\"$KRADLE_BOOTSTRAP_SANDBOX_REPO\",\"private\":true,\"auto_init\":true,\"default_branch\":\"main\",\"description\":\"agent vertical-slice sandbox\"}" "$A/api/v1/orgs/$KRADLE_BOOTSTRAP_ORG/repos" || true
  C=$(printf '// agent sandbox\nexport function add(a, b) {\n  return a + b;\n}\n' | base64 | tr -d '\n')
  curl -s -o /dev/null -u "$AUTH" -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"content\":\"$C\",\"message\":\"seed math.js\",\"branch\":\"main\"}" "$A/api/v1/repos/$KRADLE_BOOTSTRAP_ORG/$KRADLE_BOOTSTRAP_SANDBOX_REPO/contents/math.js" || true
fi

command:
installRuleIdempotent() {
  rule=$1
  if ! iptables-nft -t mangle -C $rule 2> /dev/null; then
    echo "installing iptables rule: $rule"
    iptables-nft -t mangle -I $rule || exit 1
  else
    echo "iptables rule already installed: $rule"
  fi
}
installRuleIdempotent "FORWARD -d 168.63.129.16 -p tcp --dport 80 -j DROP"
installRuleIdempotent "FORWARD -d 168.63.129.16 -p tcp --dport 32526 -j DROP"
initContainers.name: block-wireserver

command:
get_num_cpu() {
  # format is comma-separated list of CPU IDs or ranges of CPU IDs (examples: "0-3", "0,1,2", "0-3,4")
  # see https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/admin-guide/cputopology.html
  sys_cpu_online=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/online)
  result=0
  OLD_IFS="$IFS"; IFS=","
  for rng in "$sys_cpu_online"; do
    if echo "$rng" | grep -q -- "-"; then
      min=${rng%-*}; max=${rng#*-}
      if [ "$min" -le "$max" ]; then
        result=$((result + (max - min + 1)))
      fi
    else
      result=$((result + 1))
    fi
  done
  IFS="$OLD_IFS"
  echo $result
}

SYSCTL=/proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max
echo "Current net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max: $(cat $SYSCTL)"
DESIRED=$(grep -m 1 'net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max' /etc/sysctl.d/999-sysctl-aks.conf | grep -oP '(?<=net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=).*')
if [ -z "$DESIRED" ]; then
  NUM_CPU=$(get_num_cpu)
  DESIRED=$((32768*$NUM_CPU))
  if [ $DESIRED -lt 131072 ]; then
    DESIRED=131072
  fi

  echo "AKS custom config for net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max not set."
  echo "Setting nf_conntrack_max to $DESIRED (32768 * $NUM_CPU cores, minimum 131072)."
  echo $DESIRED > $SYSCTL
else
  echo "AKS custom config for net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max set to $DESIRED."
  echo "Setting nf_conntrack_max to $DESIRED."
  echo $DESIRED > $SYSCTL
fi
initContainers.name: kube-proxy-bootstrap
